articles.title: When digital access becomes a barrier to care
articles.summary: Booking care online can make life easier. It can also create another barrier. A review of nine systematic reviews examines what helps people access care and what gets in the way.
articles.author: Sasha Gladkikh
articles.imageAlt: Editorial illustration of an online appointment window and an interrupted route to care.

articles.title: An appointment is only the beginning
articles.summary: A referral gives someone an appointment. What helps them get there? Follow the roles of language, transportation, work, and caregiving.
articles.author: Rashad Charif
articles.imageAlt: An appointment card surrounded by the practical questions of understanding instructions, making time, and planning the journey.
